name: Fintech Payments Platform
description: Card payments platform: ledger, payment rails and a merchant dashboard.

agent-root.responsibilities: Own the end-to-end payments architecture, define PCI and audit constraints, and split the platform between the ledger, the payment rails and the merchant surface.

agent-ledger.responsibilities: Double-entry ledger, balances, reconciliation jobs and the immutable transaction log.

agent-ledger-db.responsibilities: Postgres schema, partitioning, migrations and retention for ledger entries.

agent-rails.responsibilities: Card network and bank integrations, idempotency, retries, webhooks and settlement files.

agent-merchant.responsibilities: Merchant dashboard, payout reporting, disputes UI and the public REST/SDK surface.
